rationale: Both Rahul and Shreya work at the intersection of robotics and computer vision — Rahul is deploying robotic systems for agricultural field labor at AgRobotics, while Shreya specializes in perception pipelines and stereo vision for robotic control. Shreya's hands-on ROS2 and computer vision expertise (C++, Python, Gazebo) could complement Rahul's field robotics engineering work, especially as AgRobotics scales its robotic deployment.
intro_message: Rahul, meet Shreya Lanjewar — she's a roboticist focused on computer vision and ROS2 systems who might have useful insights for your field robotics work at AgRobotics.
